mapper.sql: id, provider_id, endpoint, request_key, received_at, provider_observed_at, response_status, payload, expires_at
mapper.select: SELECT tp.id AS "providerId", tp.code AS "providerCode", ro.endpoint AS "endpoint", count(*) AS "totalCalls", count(*) FILTER (WHERE response_status >= 200 AND response_status < 300) AS "successfulCalls", count(*) FILTER (WHERE response_status < 200 OR response_status >= 300) AS "failedCalls", MAX(ro.received_at) AS "latestReceivedAt" FROM transit_provider tp INNER JOIN raw_observation ro ON ro.provider_id = tp.id WHERE ro.received_at >= #{receivedAfter} GROUP BY tp.id, tp.code, ro.endpoint ORDER BY "providerId" ASC, "endpoint" ASC
